name: 柯尔特射击区域
description: 柯尔特的射击区域随施法者当前位置移动并在回合结束时结算；左轮手枪与子弹风暴互斥，仅保留最新区域。
skillCode: var holder=context.rulePiece;if(!holder)return{success:false,message:''};var zones=battle.extensions&&battle.extensions.coltZones&&battle.extensions.coltZones[holder.instanceId];if(!zones||zones.turns<=0||!['revolver','storm'].includes(zones.kind)||!Number.isInteger(zones.dx)||!Number.isInteger(zones.dy)||(zones.dx===0&&zones.dy===0))return{success:false,message:''};var c=battle.pieces.find(function(p){return p.instanceId===zones.sourceId;});var zoneId='colt-zone-'+zones.sourceId;if(!c||c.currentHp<=0||c.x===null||c.y===null){if(c)removeStatusEffectById(c.instanceId,zoneId);delete battle.extensions.coltZones[holder.instanceId];return{success:false,message:''};}var zoneTag=(c.statusTags||[]).find(function(tag){return tag.id===zoneId;});var cells=[];for(var i=1;i<=6;i++){var x=c.x+zones.dx*i,y=c.y+zones.dy*i,t=battle.map.tiles.find(function(q){return q.x===x&&q.y===y;});if(!t)break;cells.push({x:x,y:y});if(zones.kind==='revolver'&&t.props.bulletPassable===false)break;}if(zones.kind==='storm')flow.effects.destroyWalls(cells);var es=battle.pieces.filter(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&!arePlayersAllied(battle,p.ownerPlayerId,c.ownerPlayerId)&&cells.some(function(q){return q.x===p.x&&q.y===p.y;});});es.sort(function(a,b){return Math.abs(a.x-c.x)+Math.abs(a.y-c.y)-Math.abs(b.x-c.x)-Math.abs(b.y-c.y);});if(zones.kind==='revolver'&&es.length)es=[es[0]];var sourceSkillId=zones.kind==='revolver'?'colt-revolver':'colt-bullet-storm';es.forEach(function(p){dealDamage(c,p,c.attack,'physical',battle,sourceSkillId)});zones.turns-=1;if(zones.turns<=0){delete battle.extensions.coltZones[holder.instanceId];removeStatusEffectById(c.instanceId,zoneId);}else if(zoneTag){zoneTag.stacks=zones.turns;zoneTag.intensity=zones.turns;}return{success:es.length>0,message:es.length?c.name+'的射击区域造成伤害':''};
